{{Quote|A beton nya mombay m'bwa!|The warlord|<ref name="Jawa" />}}
A '''Jawa warlord''' operated on an astronomical object with canyons and [[Bat/Legends|bat]]-like creatures.<ref name="Jawa" /> At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Note">''[[The Price of Victory]]'' expansion set takes place within the timeframe of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', which is set during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref> the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] was present in the vicinity of a [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] and proclaimed<ref name="Jawa" /> "This is mine, all mine!" in [[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaese]].<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> The [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], wore brown [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and [[Bandolier/Legends|bandoliers]]<ref name="Jawa" /> attributed to the [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Slip">{{WEGCite|book=Mos Eisley Adventure Set|story=There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip}}</ref> and used an [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]].<ref name="Jawa" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character was depicted on the "Jawa Warlord" card for ''[[The Price of Victory]]'', an expansion set of cards for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="Jawa" /> The Jawa was illustrated by artist [[Kerem Beyit]].<ref name="Artstation">{{ArtStation|username=kerembeyit|url=artwork/8o16|name=[[Kerem Beyit]]|text=Jawa Warlord}}</ref>
